newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Jamaica robbery victims turn on attackers.
newsitem.headline: Jamaica robbery victims turn on attackers.

text.p: Angry victims of an armed robbery in a bar in northeastern Jamaica hunted down the gunmen and hacked four of them to death, police said on Monday.
Six gunmen held up the bar in St. Mary on Saturday night, robbing patrons of cash and jewelry worth about Jamaican $15,000 (US$42,750).
They fled firing their guns but a crowd chased and caught them, killing four. Police announced no arrests.
